title: AlloyDB: `edition` Deprecated, `ExpressConfig` on Backups
summary: The `edition` field on AlloyDB `Backup` and `Cluster` resources is now deprecated. `Backup` resources now expose the `ExpressConfig` of their source cluster as an output-only field.
details: The `edition` property in both `schemas.Backup` and `schemas.Cluster` is now formally deprecated, with its enum values also marked as deprecated. Developers should transition to using the `ExpressConfig` for managing and understanding cluster editions. A new `expressConfig` property has been added to the `schemas.Backup` resource. This field is `readOnly` and provides the Express configuration of the cluster from which the backup was created. As this field is now explicitly read-only, any existing or new client code attempting to set `expressConfig` on a `Backup` resource will encounter a breaking change and fail.
